preconditions.description: Attacker must hold some amount of the PocongNFT token to perform transfers

exploit_hint: The functions excludeFromFee, includeInFee, and enableAllFees are missing the onlyOwner modifier, allowing any user to call them. First, call excludeFromFee with your address to remove all fees (tax, liquidity, burn, dev) when you transfer tokens. Then perform a token transfer to the Uniswap pair to trigger the swapAndLiquify mechanism. Since you're excluded from fees, you'll receive more tokens in return when swapping, and the contract will convert tokens to ETH and add liquidity, potentially allowing you to extract value through arbitrage or front-running.
